title: Province of Naples Travel Guide: Food, Chaos & Amalfi Strategy (2026)
introduction: Naples is not polished—and that’s exactly why it’s unforgettable. This guide helps you navigate its chaos, eat like a local, and plan Amalfi Coast efficiently.

sections.heading: Where to Explore in Naples
sections.content:
Centro Storico

The heart of Naples—dense, chaotic, and full of life.

Spaccanapoli

The most iconic walking street cutting through the city.

Vomero

Offers cleaner streets and panoramic views.

sections.heading: Food Guide: Best Pizza in Naples
sections.content:
L’Antica Pizzeria da Michele

Simple, iconic pizza.

Sorbillo

Balanced experience with variety.

Di Matteo

Best for street-style bites.

sections.heading: Pompeii & Amalfi Strategy
sections.content: Spend at least 4 hours in Pompeii. Start Amalfi trips early morning or stay overnight to avoid traffic.

seo.meta_description: Explore Naples with food, Pompeii, and Amalfi Coast strategies.

faqs.question: Is Naples safe?
faqs.answer: Yes, but stay aware in crowded areas.

faqs.question: How many days are enough?
faqs.answer: 2–3 days for city, plus Amalfi extension.
